title: HDFC Silver ETF Fund of Fund - Key Information Memorandum (KIM) & SID

sections.content: The investment objective is to seek capital appreciation by investing in units of HDFC Silver ETF. Minimum 95% of total assets is deployed in underlying Silver ETF units, providing retail investors with convenient exposure to physical silver without the storage, purity, or theft risks of physical bullion.

Minimum subscription: ₹100 for lumpsum and ₹100 for monthly SIP. The scheme provides daily liquidity via AMC redemption at applicable NAV without requiring a broker trading account. Lock-in period is zero.
